Messages.Author: salem
Messages.Body:
Creeping Infection
Type: Combat
Requires: Thanatosis
Cost: 1 blood
[thn] Strike: make a hand strike and put this card on the opposing
minion. You still control this card. When this striking vampire
announces an action, you may burn this card to prevent this minion
from blocking. A minion may have only one Creeping Infection.
[THN] As [thn] above, and this striking vampire gets +1 bleed when
bleeding this minion's controller.

At THN, do I get the +1 bleed:
a) Only if I _haven't_ burnt the card.
b) Only if i DO burn the card.
c) Whether or not I burn the card.

The "as above" makes me wonder how it interacts, exactly.

Thanks,

salem
